name: Reset Kalar
source:
A mysterious Kalar girl.

[spoiler]Reset is [url=/c735]Rance[/url] and Queen [url=/c71011]Pastel Kalar[/url]'s daughter, making her the Kalar Princess. She was conceived when Rance raped Pastel during her artificial impregnating ceremony. As the child of a Kalar rape, Reset was tasked with the Kalar duty of slaying her father in order to restore her mother's honor.[/spoiler]

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Reset_Kalar]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
